mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_delegate (grantor_id, grantee_id, request_type, status) VALUES (#{grantorId}, #{granteeId}, #{requestType}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM user_delegate WHERE grantor_id = #{grantorId} AND grantee_id = #{granteeId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'ACCEPTED') ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM user_delegate WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND ((grantor_id = #{userId} AND grantee_id = #{peerUserId}) OR (grantor_id = #{peerUserId} AND grantee_id = #{userId})) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT grantor_id FROM user_delegate WHERE grantee_id = #{granteeId} AND status = 'ACCEPTED'
